PRIVACY_POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.CONTACT: For privacy requests, information about recipients and safeguards, or to exercise your rights, contact:
PRIVACY_POLICY.CONTENT:
1. About this policy

This policy describes the personal data processed by Food Diary when you use the application. Reading this policy does not itself give consent to optional processing.

2. Data we process

  • Account details: email, authentication and profile settings, and information you choose to provide.
  • Diary and health tracking: meals, recipes, nutrients, weight, waist, cycle, fasting, hydration, exercise, goals, check-ins and uploaded photos.
  • AI inputs: meal descriptions, food images, and voice recordings submitted to the relevant feature.
  • Security and operations: IP address, device/browser information, sign-in records, error and security logs.
  • Billing and connected services: subscription and payment references, and wearable data when you connect a provider.
  • Optional campaign attribution: visitor and session identifiers, landing path, referrer host, campaign parameters and their association with signup or premium conversion.

3. Purposes and choices

We use account information to provide the service, billing information to manage subscriptions, and necessary security information to protect accounts and investigate abuse. Health tracking uses a separate explicit consent. AI features have a separate consent before data is sent to an AI provider. Optional campaign tracking starts after your opt-in; declining it does not prevent ordinary use of the application.

You can review and withdraw choices in Privacy settings. The campaign preferences control is also available on the site. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing. Privacy settings, export and account deletion remain accessible when health tracking is declined.

4. AI providers

AI features send the input needed for the requested task to an external provider such as OpenAI. API data is not used for OpenAI model training by default. We disable optional Responses application-state storage for food recognition and nutrition requests. This does not mean zero retention: standard provider abuse-monitoring logs may be retained for up to 30 days, with exceptions under the provider's terms. Actual account-level retention arrangements must be checked separately.

Your saved diary, AI recognition history and uploaded images in Food Diary have their own application lifecycle; disabling provider state storage does not delete those records.

5. Legal grounds

Necessary account and service processing relies on performance of the service contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). Optional AI and campaign processing relies on consent (Article 6(1)(a)). Health data requires both an Article 6 basis and an Article 9 condition; the health consent requests explicit consent under Article 9(2)(a). Necessary security processing may rely on legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)). Financial records may also be subject to legal obligations. The applicable grounds and retention requirements depend on the operator and deployment.

6. Recipients and international transfers

Hosting, email, payment, connected-device and AI providers may process data needed for their respective services. Providers and their locations depend on the enabled integrations. Processing may involve countries outside the EEA. Contact us for the actual recipient list, destination countries and applicable transfer safeguards. A consent checkbox alone does not establish a lawful international transfer mechanism.

7. Retention and deletion

Account and tracking records are generally retained while the account is in use or until you delete them. Account deletion first deactivates the account; permanent cleanup has a configurable delay, normally 30 days. Referenced recipe/product composition may be retained to preserve other users' records; the cleanup removes the deleted owner's free text and images from the retained source rows.

Configured defaults include 180 days for login activity and 365 days for campaign events. Campaign records linked to an account are removed during permanent account cleanup. Successfully processed billing webhook payloads are cleared; normalized payment records follow the applicable financial retention requirements. Backup, correspondence, incident and provider retention must be assessed separately.

We retain the Telegram account ID after diary deletion to prevent repeated use of the free Premium trial.

8. Your rights

Where applicable, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability and withdrawal of consent. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests and complain to a competent data protection authority, including in the country of your habitual residence, work or the alleged infringement.

Privacy settings provide an archive of the application records covered by that export. Original files, correspondence and additional infrastructure/provider records may require a separate access request. Protected fertility records use the separate verified cycle export. Contact us if you need a complete response or cannot use self-service tools. Requests are normally answered within one month; lawful extensions and exceptions may apply.

9. Security

We use access controls and technical safeguards to protect personal data. No system can promise absolute security.

10. Changes

Material changes are communicated through the service. Consent decisions record the purpose, notice version and decision time. A new consent is requested when required by a change in purpose or notice.
